title: Ranger Holt

greeting.text: The bell. A ranger in a wet coat, a torch in one hand and a folded flyer in the other. Real boots. Real breath, fogging.
Corrigan's? Thank Christ, somebody's here. Ranger Holt, Tarrow. I'm looking for two missing staff. Sam, and...
She has unfolded the flyer. Two photographs. She looks at it, and at you, and at Wren, and her whole face lets go with relief.
...and here you both are. Look at you. Not a scratch. Where have you been for three weeks?

annoyed: Sam? You're staring. Are you all right?

notes.wrist: She buys a coffee she doesn't want, to be polite. Veins. Blue. Hers.
notes.reflection: Her back in the mirror, keeping time. And behind the counter, two shapes that are not quite.
notes.shadow: One shadow. Soft. Under her, where it should be.

topics.answer: Nobody. I came on my own time. Your mum rings the station every morning, Sam. Every single morning.

wren.arrive: She's real, Sam. She's the last real one coming.
wren.adviceLine: She'll bring more. She'll look in the storeroom. Give her to me, Sam, and it's over, and it's just us. Please.

serve.text: We're fine. We lost track of time. Coffee?
Lost track of... ha! Three weeks! Your mum'll skin you.
She drinks it standing up, and takes a photo of the two of you to send down the hill. You both smile for it, perfectly.

turnAway.text: She looks at your face a second longer, and sees something in it, and goes. She leaves the torch.

shelter.text: Come out the back. There's something you should see.
Wren already has the key in their hand.

walkout.text: Sam, you're frightening me. I'm going to radio this in from the truck.
She backs out, one hand on her belt radio. Wren watches her all the way to the door.
